notes.title: Minor patch for controller functionality
notes.content: Fixed minor issue with controller configuration

notes.title: Controller Functionality!
notes.content:
Added basic controller functionality
Basic controls: 

 Left stick - character movement
 Right stick - mouse cursor movement
 Lower face button (XBOX "A" or PLAYSTATION "X") - Click/interact
 Right face button (XBOX "B" or PLAYSTATION "CIRCLE") - Exit/escape
 Left face button (XBOX "X" or PLAYSTATION "SQUARE") - Compass
 Left shoulder (XBOX "LB" or PLAYSTATION "L1") - Ability 1
 Right shoulder (XBOX "RB" or PLAYSTATION "R1") - Ability 2
 Left shoulder trigger (XBOX "LT" or PLAYSTATION "L2") - Ability 3
 Right shoulder trigger (XBOX "RT" or PLAYSTATION "R2") - Ability 4
 Start/Options - Pause game


~Misc Balancing~

 Reduced spear damage
 Increased void roar cooldown and mana cost

notes.title: Leaderboards!
notes.content:
Added leaderboards so players can compare their best waves on each map!
Also added a speedrun leaderboard - fastest escape time for each map!

- misc - 

 Added compass arrow directing to effigy and boss location

notes.title: Release!
notes.content:
Released!

Magi's Dream is finally up on Steam! It's been both a fun and difficult journey for me, especially since this is my first ever game. I hope everyone enjoys it! Also a big thank you to all supporters and wishlisters!

- Asura
